description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'RedisTbTransactionalCache' implementing cache operations with Redis, including get, put, evict, and transaction management, specifically for Thingsboard server. It handles Redis connections, serialization, and cache configuration.

classes.name: RedisTbTransactionalCache
classes.description: Abstract class providing Redis-based transactional cache operations with serialization, connection management, and cache configuration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from Redis cache for the given key, deserializing it if present.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Performs the Redis GET command for the specified key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in Redis cache.

methods.name: put(K, V, RedisConnection)
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in Redis using an existing connection.

methods.name: putIfAbsent
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair only if the key is not already present.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes a key from Redis cache.

methods.name: evict(Collection<K>)
methods.description: Removes multiple keys from Redis cache.

methods.name: evictOrPut
methods.description: Evicts a key or puts a value if key is missing.

methods.name: newTransactionForKey
methods.description: Creates a new Redis transaction for a specific key.

methods.name: newTransactionForKeys
methods.description: Creates a new Redis transaction for multiple keys.

methods.name: getAndPutInTransaction
methods.description: Performs a get and put operation within a Redis transaction.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a Redis connection, handling cluster-aware logic.

methods.name: getRawKey
methods.description: Serializes a cache key with cache name prefix.

methods.name: put(RedisConnection, K, V, SetOption)
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in Redis with specific set options.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Executes a Lua script in Redis, with fallback handling.
